experiments.title: Constant provenance and precision baseline
experiments.question: What are the current best-supported values, uncertainties, and energy-scale conventions for alpha and related couplings?
experiments.prediction: A traceable table can be built from authoritative reference data without treating 137 as exact.
method: Retrieve the latest CODATA recommended values and source notes.
Record adjustment year, uncertainty, units, and applicable regime.
Compare low-energy alpha with electroweak-scale effective coupling using a cited convention.
controls: Do not mix renormalization schemes or energy scales without labeling them.
experiments.falsification_or_failure: The baseline fails quality control if values cannot be traced to a dated authoritative source or if incompatible conventions are mixed.

experiments.title: Numerical-coincidence guardrail
experiments.question: Does any proposed relationship between inverse alpha, prime 137, and the golden angle yield a mechanism and independent prediction beyond numerical resemblance?
experiments.prediction: A valid physical relationship must specify a derivation, dimensions/conventions, and a prediction not used to construct the relationship.
method: Pre-register the candidate equation before comparing values.
Check dimensional consistency and parameter independence.
Generate predictions for at least one independent observable.
Compare against null models and account for multiple comparisons.
controls: No selecting constants or units to manufacture agreement.
Separate symbolic/cultural meaning from physical evidence.
experiments.falsification_or_failure: Reject the candidate if it only reproduces known numbers by fitted parameters, lacks a mechanism, or fails its independent prediction.

experiments.title: Evidence map for quantum measurement and observer claims
experiments.question: Which parts of the measurement process are experimentally established, and which interpretations add distinct testable predictions?
experiments.prediction: Operational results can be separated from interpretation-specific claims.
method: Map detector interaction and decoherence evidence.
Compare interpretation claims only where they produce distinguishable predictions.
Document the status of consciousness-related proposals separately.
controls: Do not equate observation with human awareness.
Do not claim decoherence alone resolves the measurement problem.
experiments.falsification_or_failure: The map is inadequate if it conflates formalism, detector physics, and metaphysical interpretation.
